visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A split-screen display shows an anime illustration on the top half and a live-action pianist on the bottom half. The woman, with long, straight black hair, wears a form-fitting black mini dress with sheer sleeves and sits at a polished black grand piano. Behind her are red pleated curtains and a grey-walled room, with several small cards placed on the piano bench. (2) The top screen transitions through cinematic anime clips, starting with a close-up of a foot stepping down and moving into a wide shot of an ornate wooden hall with glowing floor panels. The pianist below executes a vigorous performance, her hands moving rapidly across the keys while her body remains centered and focused on the instrument under bright, flat indoor lighting. (3) Close-up shots in the top panel feature a male anime character with a scarred forehead and a green checkered cloak, showing a determined facial expression. The pianist maintains high technical energy, her fingers striking the keys with precision and force, while the background remains static, showcasing the domestic studio setting where the piano is the central, large black object. (4) The top video sequence features a shirtless, muscular male character and transitions into close-ups of a Katana sword being drawn. The woman in the bottom panel continues her rhythmic playing, her posture leaning slightly into the keys as she navigates complex musical phrases. The lighting remains consistent, casting soft shadows on the pianist's back and the piano’s glossy finish. (5) Final anime clips depict a character with blonde hair in a yellow kimono sitting cross-legged before his eyes snap open in focus. The pianist finishes the piece with several strong, percussive chords, her hands lifting from the keys as the performance concludes. The overall scene remains a high-contrast blend of vibrant animation and a sober, professional studio-style piano performance.
